name: SIUT
mission: Established in 2000, SIUT North America is a charitable organization under Section 501(c)(3). It is dedicated to health-related humanitarian causes, with its major focus on helping Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) Pakistan secure vital medical funds so all patients are treated free of charge and without discrimination.
scoreSummary: SIUT shows strong alignment and moderate impact, with zakat compliance (minor risk deductions applied).
zakatClaimEvidence: SIUT North America explicitly states on its 'Ways to Donate' page: 'Zakat and Sadaqah Giving. Multiply your blessings by donating Zakat & Sadaqah to provide free medical care. Give Your Zakat.'. Additionally, their 'Inside the Mission' page states, 'Your Zakat and Sadaqah ensure that healthcare remains a right, not a privilege, for millions in need.'. Donation platforms like Kindful and Feeling Blessed also list 'Zakat' as an initiative and confirm 'Zakat eligible' for SIUT North America. (Source: https://siutna.org/ways-to-donate/)

strengths_deep_dive: SIUT North America acts as a primary international support channel for free medical care in Pakistan. In FY2024, it disbursed <cite id="4">$5,141,716 in foreign grants</cite> dedicated to medical equipment and healthcare operations, following a consistent pattern seen in its <cite id="2">FY2022 grant total of $4,153,000</cite>. Its financial health is supported by low overhead expenses, earning an <cite id="1">overall rating of 87.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. Furthermore, the organization achieves top-tier transparency recognition with a <cite id="15">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: SIUT North America provides critical funding for medical treatments, including <cite id="4">dialysis and organ transplants</cite> for underserved patients in Pakistan. Operating as a US-based support entity for the SIUT Charitable Trust in Karachi, the organization channels funds directly into medical equipment, supplies, and clinical operations. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="4">$5,931,445 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting steady growth over recent tax years. The organization holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 87.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="15">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. While its direct grantmaking model ensures funds reach clinical facilities, organizational governance and public impact metrics show room for enhanced disclosure.
